report.title: Backend filter capability matrix: domain, language, region and recency
report.question_or_target: For each search/fetch backend available here, which of the four required filters are natively supported, which are emulated client-side, and which are silently IGNORED when passed - established by sending a filter that MUST change the result set and checking whether it did?
report.answer_summary: Live replay on this checkout: Exa domain is native but leaky, language is ignored, region is native targeting, recency is native (future date emptied results). Firecrawl domain/region/recency are native and language is ignored. SearXNG language and recency are native, region is ignored, domain passthrough is ignored and domain is client-emulated. Tavily remains INFERRED because live access returned HTTP 401.
